title: Rust Fundamentals
description: Master memory-safe systems programming without garbage collection: ownership, borrowing, slices, structs, enums, pattern matching, Option/Result, traits, generics, and concurrency.
outcomes: Understand Rust ownership, move semantics, and borrow checker rules with confidence
Eliminate null and unhandled exceptions using Option, Result, and the ? operator
Write reusable zero-cost abstractions with traits, generics, and iterators
Build fast, fearless concurrent CLI tools using Cargo, crates, and threads
